english-definition: The act of fraudulently making a false document or altering a real one to be used as if genuine (Black's, p. 750)

comments: "A knowing misrepresentation of the truth or concealment of a material fact to induce another to act to his or her detriment." That said, 'falsification' is often a criminal charge that comes up during EOIR proceedings, relating to someone producing a document (birth certificate, ID, SSN, etc) that is less than legitimate.
